title: Roll configuration changes across a fleet in stages
goal: Apply a pinned configuration revision to selected canary nodes, verify health, then advance bounded waves; a failing wave pauses rollout and exposes rollback state per node. Deps (vectors): VC-201-063, VC-201-064, VC-201-065, VC-201-067. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_068_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
